```{=html}
<div id="widget-cieluv-vs-cielab" style="width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.95rem; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #1f2937;">
  <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px;">
    <label style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0;">
      <span style="font-weight: 600;">Lightness L*:</span>
      <input type="range" data-role="lstar" min="30" max="85" step="5" value="65" style="width: 140px; cursor: pointer;">
      <span data-role="lstar-val" style="min-width: 24px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600;">65</span>
    </label>
    <label style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0;">
      <span style="font-weight: 600;">Test light:</span>
      <select data-role="preset" style="padding: 3px 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; cursor: pointer;"></select>
    </label>
  </div>

  <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(290px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; align-items: start;">
    <div>
      <svg data-role="svg-lab" viewBox="0 0 360 360" style="width: 100%; max-width: 380px; height: auto; display: block; margin: 0 auto;"></svg>
    </div>
    <div>
      <svg data-role="svg-luv" viewBox="0 0 360 360" style="width: 100%; max-width: 380px; height: auto; display: block; margin: 0 auto;"></svg>
    </div>
  </div>

  <p data-role="summary" style="margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #374151;"></p>
</div>
<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById("widget-cieluv-vs-cielab");
  if (!root) return;

  const presets = [
    { name: "Neutral (D65 white)", a: 0, b: 0 },
    { name: "Red-orange", a: 45, b: 35 },
    { name: "Yellow-green", a: -20, b: 50 },
    { name: "Green", a: -45, b: 25 },
    { name: "Cyan", a: -30, b: -20 },
    { name: "Blue", a: 15, b: -50 },
    { name: "Magenta", a: 45, b: -30 }
  ];

  const lstarInput = root.querySelector('[data-role="lstar"]');
  const lstarVal = root.querySelector('[data-role="lstar-val"]');
  const presetSelect = root.querySelector('[data-role="preset"]');
  const svgLab = root.querySelector('[data-role="svg-lab"]');
  const svgLuv = root.querySelector('[data-role="svg-luv"]');
  const summaryEl = root.querySelector('[data-role="summary"]');

  presets.forEach((p, idx) => {
    const opt = document.createElement("option");
    opt.value = String(idx);
    opt.textContent = p.name;
    if (p.name === "Red-orange") opt.selected = true;
    presetSelect.appendChild(opt);
  });

  const Xn = 95.047, Yn = 100.0, Zn = 108.883;
  const denom_n = Xn + 15 * Yn + 3 * Zn;
  const un = (4 * Xn) / denom_n;
  const vn = (9 * Yn) / denom_n;
  const delta = 6 / 29;

  function finv(t) {
    return t > delta ? t * t * t : 3 * delta * delta * (t - 4 / 29);
  }

  function lab2xyz(L, a, b) {
    const fy = (L + 16) / 116;
    const fx = a / 500 + fy;
    const fz = fy - b / 200;
    return [
      Math.max(0, Xn * finv(fx)),
      Math.max(0, Yn * finv(fy)),
      Math.max(0, Zn * finv(fz))
    ];
  }

  function xyz2uv(X, Y, Z) {
    const d = X + 15 * Y + 3 * Z;
    if (d <= 0) return [0, 0];
    return [(4 * X) / d, (9 * Y) / d];
  }

  function lab2luv(L, a, b) {
    const [X, Y, Z] = lab2xyz(L, a, b);
    const [up, vp] = xyz2uv(X, Y, Z);
    return [13 * L * (up - un), 13 * L * (vp - vn)];
  }

  function lab2css(L, a, b) {
    const [X, Y, Z] = lab2xyz(L, a, b);
    const x = X / 100, y = Y / 100, z = Z / 100;
    const r =  3.2406 * x - 1.5372 * y - 0.4986 * z;
    const g = -0.9689 * x + 1.8758 * y + 0.0415 * z;
    const bl = 0.0557 * x - 0.2040 * y + 1.0570 * z;
    const compand = c => {
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, c));
      return clamped <= 0.0031308 ? 12.92 * clamped : 1.055 * Math.pow(clamped, 1 / 2.4) - 0.055;
    };
    return `rgb(${Math.round(compand(r) * 255)}, ${Math.round(compand(g) * 255)}, ${Math.round(compand(bl) * 255)})`;
  }

  function polylinePath(pts, mapX, mapY) {
    return pts.map((p, idx) => `${idx === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${mapX(p[0]).toFixed(2)},${mapY(p[1]).toFixed(2)}`).join(" ");
  }

  function renderPlot(svg, cfg) {
    const W = 360, H = 360;
    const ml = 50, mr = 16, mt = 32, mb = 44;
    const pw = W - ml - mr;
    const ph = H - mt - mb;
    const [dMin, dMax] = cfg.domain;
    const mapX = v => ml + ((v - dMin) / (dMax - dMin)) * pw;
    const mapY = v => mt + ph - ((v - dMin) / (dMax - dMin)) * ph;

    const parts = [];
    parts.push(`<rect x="${ml}" y="${mt}" width="${pw}" height="${ph}" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d1d5db" stroke-width="1"/>`);
    parts.push(`<clipPath id="${cfg.clipId}"><rect x="${ml}" y="${mt}" width="${pw}" height="${ph}"/></clipPath>`);

    // Grid and tick labels
    for (const t of cfg.ticks) {
      const gx = mapX(t);
      const gy = mapY(t);
      parts.push(`<line x1="${gx.toFixed(1)}" y1="${mt}" x2="${gx.toFixed(1)}" y2="${mt + ph}" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1"/>`);
      parts.push(`<line x1="${ml}" y1="${gy.toFixed(1)}" x2="${ml + pw}" y2="${gy.toFixed(1)}" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1"/>`);
      parts.push(`<text x="${gx.toFixed(1)}" y="${mt + ph + 16}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#4b5563">${t}</text>`);
      parts.push(`<text x="${ml - 8}" y="${(gy + 4).toFixed(1)}" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" fill="#4b5563">${t}</text>`);
    }

    // Zero axes
    parts.push(`<line x1="${mapX(0).toFixed(1)}" y1="${mt}" x2="${mapX(0).toFixed(1)}" y2="${mt + ph}" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-dasharray="3,3" stroke-width="1"/>`);
    parts.push(`<line x1="${ml}" y1="${mapY(0).toFixed(1)}" x2="${ml + pw}" y2="${mapY(0).toFixed(1)}" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-dasharray="3,3" stroke-width="1"/>`);

    // Clipped data layer
    parts.push(`<g clip-path="url(#${cfg.clipId})">`);
    for (const line of cfg.gridSeries) {
      parts.push(`<path d="${polylinePath(line, mapX, mapY)}" fill="none" stroke="#cfd8dc" stroke-width="1"/>`);
    }
    if (cfg.refCircle) {
      parts.push(`<path d="${polylinePath(cfg.refCircle, mapX, mapY)}" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-dasharray="4,4" stroke-width="1.6"/>`);
    }
    parts.push(`<path d="${polylinePath(cfg.contour, mapX, mapY)}" fill="none" stroke="${cfg.contourColor}" stroke-width="2.2"/>`);
    parts.push(`<circle cx="${mapX(cfg.center[0]).toFixed(1)}" cy="${mapY(cfg.center[1]).toFixed(1)}" r="6" fill="${cfg.centerColor}" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="1.5"/>`);
    parts.push(`</g>`);

    // Title & axis labels
    parts.push(`<text x="${(ml + pw / 2).toFixed(1)}" y="20" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#111827">${cfg.title}</text>`);
    parts.push(`<text x="${(ml + pw / 2).toFixed(1)}" y="${H - 8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#374151">${cfg.xLabel}</text>`);
    parts.push(`<text x="15" y="${(mt + ph / 2).toFixed(1)}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#374151" transform="rotate(-90 15 ${(mt + ph / 2).toFixed(1)})">${cfg.yLabel}</text>`);

    svg.innerHTML = parts.join("");
  }

  function update() {
    const L = Number(lstarInput.value);
    lstarVal.textContent = String(L);
    const preset = presets[Number(presetSelect.value)] || presets[1];
    const radius = 15;
    const a0 = preset.a;
    const b0 = preset.b;
    const [u0, v0] = lab2luv(L, a0, b0);
    const centerColor = lab2css(L, a0, b0);

    const labCircle = [];
    const luvContour = [];
    const refUvCircle = [];
    let minDEuv = Infinity;
    let maxDEuv = 0;

    const N = 72;
    for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
      const theta = (2 * Math.PI * i) / N;
      const a = a0 + radius * Math.cos(theta);
      const b = b0 + radius * Math.sin(theta);
      const [u, v] = lab2luv(L, a, b);
      const dEuv = Math.hypot(u - u0, v - v0);
      if (i < N) {
        if (dEuv < minDEuv) minDEuv = dEuv;
        if (dEuv > maxDEuv) maxDEuv = dEuv;
      }
      labCircle.push([a, b]);
      luvContour.push([u, v]);
      refUvCircle.push([u0 + radius * Math.cos(theta), v0 + radius * Math.sin(theta)]);
    }

    const labGrid = [];
    const luvGrid = [];
    const vals = [-60, -30, 0, 30, 60];
    for (const av of vals) {
      const lg = [], ug = [];
      for (let bv = -60; bv <= 60; bv += 5) {
        lg.push([av, bv]);
        ug.push(lab2luv(L, av, bv));
      }
      labGrid.push(lg);
      luvGrid.push(ug);
    }
    for (const bv of vals) {
      const lg = [], ug = [];
      for (let av = -60; av <= 60; av += 5) {
        lg.push([av, bv]);
        ug.push(lab2luv(L, av, bv));
      }
      labGrid.push(lg);
      luvGrid.push(ug);
    }

    renderPlot(svgLab, {
      clipId: "clip-cielab-plot",
      title: `CIELAB (a*, b*) at L* = ${L}`,
      xLabel: "a* (red–green)",
      yLabel: "b* (yellow–blue)",
      domain: [-90, 90],
      ticks: [-80, -40, 0, 40, 80],
      gridSeries: labGrid,
      contour: labCircle,
      contourColor: "#1f2937",
      center: [a0, b0],
      centerColor
    });

    renderPlot(svgLuv, {
      clipId: "clip-cieluv-plot",
      title: `CIELUV (u*, v*) at L* = ${L}`,
      xLabel: "u*",
      yLabel: "v*",
      domain: [-110, 110],
      ticks: [-100, -50, 0, 50, 100],
      gridSeries: luvGrid,
      refCircle: refUvCircle,
      contour: luvContour,
      contourColor: "#b91c1c",
      center: [u0, v0],
      centerColor
    });

    summaryEl.innerHTML =
      `<strong>Selected test light (${preset.name}):</strong> ` +
      `(a*, b*) = (${a0.toFixed(0)}, ${b0.toFixed(0)}) &rarr; ` +
      `(u*, v*) = (${u0.toFixed(1)}, ${v0.toFixed(1)}). ` +
      `Around the constant &Delta;E*<sub>ab</sub> = 15 circle (solid), ` +
      `&Delta;E*<sub>uv</sub> ranges from <strong>${minDEuv.toFixed(1)}</strong> ` +
      `to <strong>${maxDEuv.toFixed(1)}</strong> ` +
      `(dashed circle shows &Delta;E*<sub>uv</sub> = 15).`;
  }

  lstarInput.addEventListener("input", update);
  presetSelect.addEventListener("change", update);
  update();
})();
</script>
```
